questions.add_vs_remove: Vanilla loader adds GT6 vanilla-adjacent recipes. Replace removes or substitutes vanilla recipes. A later card must keep those axes distinct.
questions.asm_vs_datapack: ASM Replacements is bytecode, not a recipe JSON. NeoForge recipe conditions are not a GT6 transformer.
questions.disposition_policy: Per-category later cards must choose implemented, planned, deferred, or out_of_scope. R0 does not fill those dispositions.
questions.fail_closed: Unknown vanilla recipe must not silent no-op.
questions.load: A later implementation card measures recipe addition, deletion, and substitution separately; it cannot share a hopper or mold-firing owner.
questions.minecraft_namespace: Whether a later card may write data/minecraft recipe overrides. R0 must not create that tree.
questions.player_acquisition: Whether survival still has vanilla crafting-table and furnace recipes.
